pairs.why: B's slide has softer, smoother edges with few internal lines and a pale-rimmed pool edge like the real one, while A has thin rail/brace linework and a busier edge density.
Both ropes have nearly identical soft edges and similar twisted strand lines, with no meaningful edge difference.
B's helmet has a crisp, thin visor rim and seam lines with detailed panel edges like the real items, while A's blobby sphere has few edges and a heavy rim.
A's housing edges are smooth and soft with a simple vent slit and no extra hard seam line, closer to the real unit than B's thin crisp panel gap and white rim.
A's cooler has a softer, rounder silhouette with pillowy rim edges like the real one, while B has a thinner, sharper lid line and handle.
A's keys and body have soft rounded edges and uniform contour like the real calculator, while B's tighter key gaps and darker outlines make it busier.
A has bold, simplified edges and its buttons and platter have clear, softly separated contours like the real controller, while B is smaller with finer, denser detail edges.
A's lamp has a clean soft-edged barrel with a few separated seams like the real one, while B's vent slots and lattice truss add more edge density and darker contour lines.
